chapter_title: The Chapter on whether any [Lig]ht comes from the Three Vessels
chapter_note: Short, predominantly substrate chapter describing the cosmological mechanism by which light is refined from the three vessels surrounding the universe. The teaching describes gates at four compass points opening downward to the vessels, light rays entering through these openings, and a purification/clarification process through the firmaments. The only editorial overlay is the standard dialogue frame attribution in paragraphs 1 and 2. No editorial bridge, institutional, or exhortation material detected. The teaching is systematic cosmic-process description — both sides of every mapping remain within the cosmic architecture (vessels, gates, firmaments, rays, light, living ones). This is a compact, well-preserved substrate teaching unit.

paragraphs.core_text: For four [gates o]pen in each world, distributed at the four points of the compass, opening downwards to the vessels. So, due to this, the [light of the] rays shall go in through these openings and it shines on [that] place, and pulls through them the light and the little pi[llar (?) that ex]ists there.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure cosmological architecture: four gates at four compass points, opening downward to the vessels, light rays entering through openings, pulling light and the pillar. Systematic spatial description — 'each world', 'four points of the compass' — mapping cosmic geography. Both sides of every description remain within the cosmic system. The 'little pi[llar]' may be a technical term for a light-conduit within the vessel.

paragraphs.core_text: From that place [it] shall be poured [out to the] firmaments. It shall also be clarified in these firmaments [ ... ] a part there is cleansed and it is [all] taken up with the living ones. However, its other part [ ... ] shall all [be cast] down.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic purification process: light poured to firmaments, clarified, cleansed, separated — one part taken up with the living ones, the other cast down. This is the classic substrate separation/refinement vocabulary. The substrate score (12.24) is the highest in the chapter. The binary separation (taken up / cast down) is a fundamental cosmological-correspondential pattern. Despite lacunae, the teaching structure is clear.
